source.publisher: Gmina Miejska Kraków / BIP Miasta Krakowa

field_definitions.data_granularity: source observations aggregated per day, point, 15-minute time interval, direction, infrastructure, sex

measurements.bicycles_total: sum of private and Wavelo bicycle counts (not unique individuals)
measurements.helmets: Kask counts, not additional cyclists; potentially a subset
measurements.uto: Separate UTO counts, not included in bicycles_total
measurements.pedestrians: Separate pedestrians, not included in bicycles_total

field_definitions.direction_codes: Original A/B/C/D/E/F/O codes; actual geographic bearings not documented in XLSX and require source maps
field_definitions.infrastructure_original: Exact original spreadsheet labels retained; numeric suffixes distinguish sublocations
field_definitions.synthesis_8h_peak_is_separate: Published 8-hour figures cross-checked against 07:30–11:30 and 15:45–19:45 intervals in XLSX; full interval totals may be larger
field_definitions.time_interval_note: Intervals are local time; midnight crossing and irregular labels retained
field_definitions.location_note: XLSX has no verifiable coordinates; points intentionally have null geometries
